sre-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: canary failure spike detected after schema migration v2. 500s up ~18% in eu-west-1. Auto-rollout paused and page sent to @oncall-jordan. Runbook: /runbooks/db-migration-rollback.

oncall-jordan: On it — will gather logs and confirm blast radius. Any immediate customer impact?

sre-bot: Some requests returned 500 with message "column 'embedding_vector' not found". Affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings, /v1/generate (canary only so far).

maya: I see the same in canary logs. The migration added a new column to embedding_store and the canary replicas are hitting the new schema while older workers expect v1. Likely schema drift between app and migration.

kyle: Suggestion: flip feature flag db_v2_enabled -> false for canary traffic first (warm rollback) to avoid global cache invalidation. Avoid immediate DB rollback if we can.

ella: I can toggle flags. Will target canary first. Executing: `/flags toggle db_v2_enabled --env=canary --value=false`

sre-bot: Flag toggle recorded: flag-service/ops by ella at 1725554332. Health probes scheduled every 30s.

maya: Canary error rate has dropped back to baseline (from 19% -> 3%) within one probe window. No new 500s in canary.

oncall-jordan: Good. Please proceed to global flip but warn customers about potential short tail latencies during connection rebind. Any risk to existing long-lived KV caches?

kyle: Risk low — we coordinated cache namespaces. Global flip starting. Command:```
flagctl set db_v2_enabled=false --scope=global --reason="rollback after canary schema mismatch"
```

ella: Global flag set to false. Propagation complete. Running smoke tests across eu, na, ap.

sre-bot: Post-action metrics: 200OK at 99.8% across regions, error count returned to baseline. Canary and prod stable. Incident marked mitigated.

maya: Next steps: block further deploys that touch embedding_store schema, open a rollback ticket for the DB migration with ops-runbook steps, and schedule a postmortem. I'm creating INC-17255 and adding runbook links.

oncall-jordan: Copy. I'll lead the follow-up and coordinate with the migration owner. Leaving the thread but will monitor. Ping if regressions. :white_check_mark:
